description: Replace one connector by its id. This replaces the connector rather than patching it, so send the full definition you want it to end up with - read mba_get_connector first.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

auth_config.description: Credentials matching auth_type: `api_key` when auth_type is API_KEY, `oauth2_client_credentials` when it is OAUTH2_CLIENT_CREDENTIALS. Credentials can also be set later with upsert_connector_api_key or upsert_connector_oauth.

api_key.description: Where the API key is injected. Supply at least one of headers, query_params, body_params.

field_name.description: Header, query or body field name.
Header, query or body field name.
Header, query or body field name.

base_url.description: Base URL every tool on this connector calls.

requires_certificate.description: True when the system needs mTLS; upload the certificate with upsert_connector_certificate.

user_auth_injection_config.description: Optional configuration for injecting a per-user token into tool requests.

name: mba_update_connector
title: Update a connector
